row:
Bear left at a trail junction.
Climb over Arch Cape to
Hwy 101. Cross Hwy 101
and return to the trail.

Hike 3.5 mi to
Cape Falcon, then
to Oswald West.

At Neahkahnie Mtn South
trailhead, follow gravel
road uphill and through a
gate east of parking area.
Trail continues about 100'
south of the gate.

Cross Hwy 101 at Nehalem Rd; follow
road to beach access, then head south
on the beach. Alternate route to beach:
Continue south on Hwy 101; take Laneda
Ave to beach. Alternate route on hwy:
Take Hwy 101 south around Nehalem Bay
through Wheeler.

Jetty Fishery (800-821-7697)
provides ferry service across Nehalem
Bay. After the boat ride, walk
toward Hwy 101 then head south for
1/2 mile. Take staircase and cross
railroad tracks to Section Line St.
Return to the beach and head south
at Nedonna Beach (#24).

Follow signs for Three
Capes Scenic Route to
Cape Lookout State Park

Take Meares Ave
to beach. Take Big
Spruce Beach Trail
to top of cape.

At the Cape Lookout State
Park day-use area, take
the North Trail to ascend
to Cape Lookout.

Head west on the Cape
Trail. Take a hard left to
follow the South Trail and
17 descend to the beach.
